messages:
maya: posted an updated prototype for the trace viewer action bar. main ask: should export be a primary action or tucked in kebab? figma: https://redwood.test/figma/trace-viewer-actions
tony: i think export is a primary during incident triage. folks frequently download traces for postmortems. putting it in kebab hides the affordance.
jess: a11y flag: kebab has no accessible name currently. also icon-only primary buttons need 44px hit targets and visible focus styles.
maya: proposal: make three primaries: [Copy correlation ID] [Open trace] [Export trace]. kebab contains: Pin, Annotate, Share link.
ukai: slight tweak: label the export as "Download trace" rather than "Export" 14 more concrete for non-technical users.
kai: engineering note: export runs async and can be large. we should show an unobtrusive progress toast and add a persistent download chip in the header until expiry. also manifest.json inside archive for reproducibility.
tony: copy nit: "Copy correlation ID" beats "Copy ID". for stack frames, "Copy frame location" is clearer than "Copy stack frame".
jess: keyboard shortcuts: C=copy id, O=open, D=download/export. avoid single-letter conflicts with editor shortcuts within embedded consoles. include shortcut hints in tooltip and keyboard help modal.
maya: accessibility detail: on export start, announce via aria-live: "Trace download started. A link will appear in notifications when ready." on completion, focusable toast should be inserted.
kai: implementer question: for copy actions, do we copy raw id only? or include a tiny URL? i'd vote raw id by default, and "Copy with link" as kebab action.
tony: UX for small screens: collapse to icon-only for primaries but ensure aria-labels present. long-press can reveal text labels. touch target 44px.
jess: contrast problem found in prototype: subtle icon hover is 2.6:1. need to increase contrast or add a visible outline on focus (4.5:1). also ensure role="toolbar" on actions container and that tab order matches visual order.
maya: ordering decision: left-aligned primaries, then a spacer, then metadata and kebab on right. keeps primary tasks immediate when scanning left-to-right.
kai: i'll implement toolbar semantics and focus management. for downloads, filename pattern suggestion: trace-<id>-<env>-<ISOts>.zip. inside include manifest.json with export options.
tony: tiny UX add: after export completes show a small ephemeral banner linked to the trace so users can re-open or re-download for 24 hours. skip making notifications noisy.
ux-helper: accessibility check: ensure modal dialogs (if used for export options) trap focus and include aria-describedby for long descriptions. also ensure checkboxes include labels.
maya: quick decision: export modal only for advanced options; default quick-download when clicking primary. advanced accessible modal from kebab.
jess: action items: maya update figma with "Download trace" wording, 44px targets, toolbar role. kai to add aria-live flow and persistent chip behavior. tony to prototype mobile long-press reveal. i'll re-run a11y checklist after updates.
maya: thanks all 44d will post updated frames by EOD and tag for design crit.
